detail.text: Count every delivery line before posting. Compare the counted quantity with the quantity on the delivery note and on the purchase order.

A count of 99 against an ordered quantity of 100 is a deviation of 1 unit. That is within the smaller of 2% of 100 (2 units) and 2 units, so post 99 as counted with a note in the goods receipt. Do not hold the posting for a shift-lead recount.
Post the goods receipt in the WMS against the purchase order line.
